protocol_adapter.evidence: forgecad-mcp Rust unit tests, protocol snapshot, probe_mcp003_stdio.py and an official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk StdioClientTransport probe; the raw probe now covers canonical 2025-11-25 and Codex 2025-06-18 compatibility; none of these rows alone claim a Codex host connection

codex_desktop.reason: Desktop host is controlled by the Codex app and cannot be invoked by this repository-only Gate.

codex_cli.evidence: codex mcp get forgecad with an ephemeral config override parsed the forgecad stdio command, args, env var names and writes approval policy without modifying user config. A real authenticated codex exec invocation then started an isolated read-only thread and completed exactly capabilities_get and selection_get against forgecad; both returned structured read-only results and no project, Runtime or user configuration write occurred. A second authenticated run with CODEX_MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION=2026-07-28 returned the expected unsupported-protocol response with no MCP call or downgrade. See docs/evidence/mcp003/codex-cli-e2e.json.
codex_cli.reason: Authenticated CLI read-only E2E passed; a separate no-auth probe was a prior diagnostic 401 and is not the acceptance result.

codex_ide.reason: IDE extension restart and MCP inspection require the user-facing Codex IDE host.

computer_use_host_probe.evidence: A read-only Computer Use state request for com.openai.codex was denied by the host safety boundary. A subsequent app discovery request reported that the Mac was locked and automatic unlock was unavailable. No UI click, typing, upload, configuration change or host-side MCP action was performed.
computer_use_host_probe.reason: Final Desktop/IDE acceptance must be performed by the user in an unlocked, user-owned host session; repository automation must not bypass this boundary.

codex_app_server_diagnostic.evidence: Temporary CODEX_HOME, no model turn, no user config mutation: Codex Desktop/0.147.0-alpha.6.5 app-server started an ephemeral read-only thread, first reproduced the 2025-06-18 mismatch, then after the explicit compatibility implementation emitted startup ready, mcpServerStatus/list with 14 tools and one resource, and mcpServer/tool/call selection_get returned structuredContent with available=false. This is a bounded app-server host diagnostic, not final Desktop UI/CLI/IDE acceptance.
